manifest.benchmark: AstraDJ runtime performance and Soundclash diagnostics

method.api: Loopback GET /api/v1/tracks?limit=10; Server-Timing is app-path duration; Mongo subquery spans are not instrumented.
method.segue: Authenticated Host outro-trigger and playback.ended commands using source-evidenced seed pair; no browser or actual audio.
method.soundclash: Authenticated Listener submissions with {trackId}; inspect durable snapshot, outbox and projected QueueEvent after ack/timeout.
method.rateLimits: Production limiter remains enabled; only isolated database counters reset between workload batches.

levels.note: Normal rate limiting remained active; only disposable Mongo counters were cleared between batches. DB subquery spans are not instrumented.

result.latencyLimitations: The Host uses authenticated Socket.IO commands with currentTs inside the configured outro window. Opt-in spans cover Lounge lookup, current-track lookup, candidate retrieval, acoustic eligibility/ranking and transition-script/reference generation. The harness then sends lounge.playback.ended directly; no browser media element or React render is part of these timings. Peer Socket.IO arrival is not browser render latency.

result.note: Milestones use 1ms polling from the benchmark process and are upper bounds including poll/query time.
